submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.095%) at Sb fraction 0.52. That is close to AgSbO3 stoichiometry, and XRD shows the pyrochlore AgSbO3 phase dominates there (222 at Q≈2.13, 400 at 2.46, 440 at 3.47). The Ag-rich side shows metallic Ag and a second phase and has lower EQE. A quadratic fit through the measurements puts the EQE peak near x≈0.51.
